rationale: B is clearer, more idiomatic, and substantially less complex: it exploits the symmetry of the five titles to consider only each possible group size, whereas A enumerates every nonempty title subset and repeatedly explores equivalent states. Its integer-cent pricing, naming, documentation, and compact cached recurrence make the algorithm easier to understand and maintain. Although `basket.count` performs repeated scans and assumes the expected title identifiers 1 through 5, those are minor within the stated domain and are outweighed by B's simpler state transition and smaller search space.
